description_ru: Лена и папа готовят блины, первый улетает на окно, а мама показывает главный секрет.
text:
Lena: Dad, are you awake? It is Sunday! You said we can make pancakes today.
Dad: Mmm. What time is it?
Lena: It is eight o'clock. I am hungry, and the cat is hungry too.
Dad: Okay, okay. I get up. Go to the kitchen and find the big bowl.
Lena: I have it. And I have the flour, the eggs and the milk. Look, I am a real cook!
Dad: Very good. Now put two cups of flour in the bowl.

Lena: One cup, two cups. Oh no. Some flour is on the floor.
Dad: That is fine. And some is on your nose.
Lena: Dad! Stop laughing. Now what?
Dad: Now we need two eggs. Can you break them? Hit the egg on the side of the bowl, gently.
Lena: Gently. One, two... Oh, there is a piece of egg shell in the bowl.
Dad: Don't worry. Take it out with a spoon. Every cook does this sometimes.
Lena: Even you?
Dad: Especially me. Last year, I put a whole egg in the bowl with the shell on it. Your mother said it was the crunchiest pancake in the world.
Lena: Ha ha! I like crunchy food.

Dad: Now add the milk, and mix it slowly. Not too fast, Lena.
Lena: I mix slowly. It looks like yellow soup.
Dad: That is right. This is good. Now we heat the pan. This part is for me, because the pan is hot.
Lena: Can I watch?
Dad: Of course. Stand here, not too close. First a little butter. See? It goes soft and sings.
Lena: It sings? I hear it. Tsss.
Dad: Now one spoon of the soup into the pan. Wait. Wait. Now look at the top. Do you see small bubbles?
Lena: Yes, many small bubbles!
Dad: Now I turn it over. Ready? One, two, three!

Lena: Wow! It goes up in the air!
Dad: And it comes down in the pan. Perfect!
Lena: Dad, it is not in the pan. It is on the window.
Dad: What? Oh. Hmm. Yes. The first pancake is always a practice one.
Lena: A practice pancake on the window. Mum is going to be so angry.
Dad: Don't tell Mum. Quick, give me the cloth.
Mum: Don't tell Mum what?
Dad: Oh. Good morning, my love. We make a nice breakfast for you, a very nice one.
Mum: I see. I see a big mess in my kitchen and a pancake on my window.

Lena: It is my fault, Mum. I asked him to throw it high.
Dad: No, it is my fault. I am the one who threw it.
Mum: Both of you are very kind. Now give me the pan. I show you the secret.
Lena: Is there a secret?
Mum: Yes. The secret is a small fire and a lot of patience. Dad's fire is too big and his patience is too small.
Dad: That is a little true.
Mum: Lena, you pour. Dad, you wash the window. I watch.
Dad: Yes, boss.

Lena: Mum, look! This one is round and golden.
Mum: It is beautiful. Now we make eight more. What do you want on top?
Lena: Honey and strawberries, please. And a little sugar.
Dad: Not too much sugar. Remember your teeth.
Lena: Okay. Only a tiny bit.
Mum: Dad, what do you want?
Dad: Just butter. And a cup of strong coffee. A very, very strong coffee.

Lena: Dad, I have a good idea. We take a pancake to Mrs. Green next door. She is alone on Sundays.
Dad: That is a lovely idea. Put two on a plate.
Lena: And one for the cat?
Mum: No, no. Cats don't eat pancakes.
Lena: But Mum, he looks at me like this. Please, please.
Mum: Okay, a very small piece. But on the floor, not on the table.
Lena: Thank you. Here, Tiger. Eat your breakfast.
Dad: Look at him. He loves it.

Mrs. Green: Oh, what a nice surprise. Who makes these?
Lena: I do! With my dad and my mum. And a little help from the window.
Mrs. Green: From the window? What does that mean?
Dad: It is a long story, Mrs. Green.
Lena: Our first pancake flew to the window. Next Sunday, I make a better one. Please come to our house!
Mrs. Green: I come with pleasure. I bring my own jam, and I sit far from the window.
Dad: Very wise.
Lena: Dad, I have one more question. Can we make pancakes every Sunday?
Dad: Every Sunday. But next time, nobody throws anything.
Lena: Not even a little one?
Mum: Not even a little one.

focus_sounds.tip_ru: Короткий звук между «а» и «э», рот полуоткрыт; не произносите «о».
Начните с «а» и плавно перейдите в «у»; звук слитный.
Губы округлите и вытяните вперёд, без касания зубами; не произносите «в».
Лёгкий выдох из горла, без русского хрипа «х».

questions.question: What happens to the first pancake?
questions.answer: It flies up and lands on the window.

questions.question: What is the secret of good pancakes, according to Mum?
questions.answer: A small fire and a lot of patience.

questions.question: Who do they take pancakes to?
